title: Just KIDDIN’ : Knowledge Infusion and Distillation for Detection of INdecent Memes

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation through interpretability analysis of memes depicting racial discrimination (e.g., interracial relationships) and failure analysis of model misclassifications incorrectly linking specific facial features (e.g., 'thin eyes') to offensive stereotypes.

Qualitative failure analysis of model misclassifications caused by spurious associations in the training data, such as the model incorrectly hallucinating sexist context in benign memes featuring women and household appliances (dishwashers).

Qualitative evaluation of the model's interpretability and reasoning capabilities in detecting Islamophobia, specifically using knowledge sub-graphs to analyze memes contrasting the perceived experiences of entering versus leaving Islam.
